feed.title: Awesome Egocentric Atlas updates
feed.subtitle: Resources ordered by first-publication month; access dates are recorded in the catalog.

entry.title: Xp-Teleop
entry.summary: 27 Unitree G1 humanoid episodes, 543 action segments, and 96,064 frames with clean head RGB, keypoints, masks, calibration, and IMU

entry.title: TouchScale
entry.summary: Current release: 100 hours, 15,324 episodes, 929 tasks, and 193 object meshes; synchronized head RGB-D, wrist RGB, and 880 tactile taxels per hand

entry.title: STOU
entry.summary: Paper: 2,902 video-audio/text safety queries; gated release: 1,952 instances over 713 source clips, separating harm understanding from refusal

entry.title: SOMA
entry.summary: 1,632 human-verified questions on body configuration, motion dynamics, and temporal reasoning from first-person video

entry.title: Ropedia W0
entry.summary: Camera-pose and skeleton-conditioned loco-manipulation world model trained with 10K human and 3K robot hours; 5B pre-trained and mid-trained checkpoints released

entry.title: ProactEgoMem
entry.summary: 300 daily-life and 100 scientific clips; 1,500 QA items testing proactive information capture, state tracking, and location tracking

entry.title: PWM / PWM-Bench
entry.summary: 150 first-person world-model customization tasks across indoor, outdoor, and Minecraft scenes; 300 paired support/test videos and 33,750 frames

entry.title: NextMe-800 / NextAct
entry.summary: 795 hours from one Aria wearer across a 126-day span, with 527 recordings on 114 recording days; gaze, audio, five-level captions, and a 1,500-point NextAct benchmark

entry.title: EgoVoice
entry.summary: Proactive spoken assistance from HoloAssist-derived video/audio streams, jointly evaluating speech timing and guidance content

entry.title: EgoExo-Next
entry.summary: 2,503 human-curated four-choice questions from six ego/ego-exo sources, testing visual next-state prediction and cross-view correspondence

entry.title: EgoDatasets
entry.summary: Dataset-centric taxonomy of 96 resources from 2008-2026: 79 core egocentric/multiview datasets and 17 contextual exocentric datasets

entry.title: Ego-SpaCR / SpaC-MEM
entry.summary: 620 ScanNet video sessions, 95 task-oriented conversations, and 3,100 evaluation queries for spatially grounded conversational memory

entry.title: EMBER-Bench
entry.summary: 189 recorded household tasks and 699 history-dependent questions: 548 next-action predictions and 151 causal traceback questions

entry.title: Argus
entry.summary: Dense video annotation and data-quality checks across LeRobot, MCAP, and video archives; publisher reports 3,546 audited human/robot episodes across nine datasets

entry.title: XPACE
entry.summary: Joint future-video and action modeling from heterogeneous human and robot experience, including simulated recoveries for policy improvement

entry.title: TempCloze
entry.summary: 1,521 videos from seven sources for selecting a missing middle clip; separates semantic plausibility, temporal alignment, and progression

entry.title: SlugTrails
entry.summary: Aria recordings across three campus buildings and six floors, with CAD floor plans, survey-aligned trajectories, and single-frame, sweep, and walking-stream protocols

entry.title: RekaDaily-10k (processed)
entry.summary: Dataset card reports 6,373,064 clips and 10,200 hours; captions and question-answer exchanges are model-generated

entry.title: MINT / EgoPipeline
entry.summary: Joint world-space camera and two-hand trajectory prediction; public checkpoint, training/inference code, EgoPipeline, and non-video annotations covering 1,021 hours

entry.title: IronMind
entry.summary: Humanoid VLA pretraining on human ego video and robot data using camera-space actions; studies budgets from 250 to 10,000 hours

entry.title: HumanVerse-500 / lambda_0
entry.summary: Reported 500-hour wearable corpus synchronizing egocentric video with body and hand motion, used by the lambda_0 humanoid loco-manipulation policy

entry.title: HuRo
entry.summary: Reported 630K robotized episodes and 142M frames from five human egocentric sources; aligns rendered robot observations with retargeted actions

entry.title: Gen-HumanEgo
entry.summary: Publisher reports 1,847.7 hours, 44,632 episodes, 10,257 tasks, six synchronized RGB cameras, reconstructed 3D hands, depth, and hierarchical annotations

entry.title: Eidon Tracker POV
entry.summary: 1,273.8 hours and 13,451 head-camera recordings from 27 contributors, paired with seven-slot upper-body IMU streams at 24 Hz

entry.title: Eidon Egocentric POV
entry.summary: 305.7 hours and 1,370 head-mounted video-only recordings from 37 contributors, without the Tracker POV IMU harness

entry.title: Eidon Capture and Playback Tools
entry.summary: Public wearable IMU hardware/firmware, glove designs, and Eidon Sim for arm kinematics and video-synchronized trajectory playback

entry.title: EgoWild / EgoWild2Dex
entry.summary: Reported 538.9 hours, 179,049 episodes, 125,961 task descriptions, and 1,282 object categories from in-the-wild head-camera manipulation

entry.title: EgoTSR++ / SpatialLogic-Bench
entry.summary: Goal-conditioned progress reasoning from bidirectional state pairs, with order-robust comparisons and long-horizon failure/recovery evaluation

entry.title: EgoPathBench
entry.summary: 31,852 training, 1,345 validation, and 1,111 benchmark questions for traversability, waypoint routes, and intent-conditioned paths from first-person RGB

entry.title: Ego4WAM
entry.summary: Controlled world-action-model study separating human-robot alignment, duration, task diversity, action labels, and training-stage effects
